content: Hello Abinash! Nice to meet you. How can I help you today?
do you remember everything what I say even after I delete it?

**No, I do not.** 

Here is how it works:

1. **In this chat:** I only have access to the active text currently visible in our conversation window. If you delete a message, it is removed from my active memory (context window), and I can no longer see or reference it.
2. **Long-term memory:** I do not retain personal information or learn from our individual conversation to store it permanently. Once a chat session is cleared or deleted, it is completely gone from my awareness.

*(Note: Depending on the platform you are using to access this AI, backend systems may briefly log conversations for safety and moderation purposes according to their privacy policy, but **I as the AI** cannot see, recall, or access anything you have deleted.)*
if I close this code and open again will you remember it?

**No, I will not remember it if you close the chat and start a new session.** 

Here is what happens:

* **If you open a brand-new chat:** I start completely fresh. I won't know your name or anything we discussed previously.
* **If you return to this exact same chat thread** (from your chat history): The application will reload our previous messages into my context, so I will be able to read what we said before and continue the conversation.

Once a session is closed or deleted, my memory of it is completely reset.
I don't know your name yet! Since I don't have access to your personal information, you'll have to tell me. What is your name?

Your name is **Abinash Oli**! 

Since we are still in the same chat thread, I can look back at the beginning of our conversation where you told me your name.
bro I finally completed a major task

Congratulations, Abinash! That's awesome news. Finishing a major project or task is a great feeling. 

What was the task you completed? Tell me about it!
I succeed to implement the history of our chat

That is awesome, Abinash! 🚀

Managing chat history—by keeping track of past messages and passing them back to the API so the AI remembers context—is a huge milestone when building an AI application!

How did you end up building it? Are you storing the message history in an array in your code, or saving it to a database like Redis, MongoDB, or PostgreSQL?

Your name is Abinash Oli! 

And seriously, congratulations again on successfully implementing the chat history in your code. That's a huge achievement! Let me know if you want to test it out or talk about any other features you're adding next.
